and_or_ambiguity.quote: Documentation of a minimum 6-week history of shoulder, neck, or back pain ... This includes documentation of the presence of shoulder grooving ... OR Recurrent or chronic intertrigo
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Is shoulder grooving required with the pain pathway ('This includes') or just an example?

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Documented tanner stage IV or V for members aged 15-18, AND Stable height measurements for 6 months, OR Puberty completion as shown on wrist radiograph
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Precedence of AND/OR; what about under 15?

and_or_ambiguity.quote: a minimum of 500g per breast removed OR the surgeon should follow the below Schnur sliding scale ... if the planned weight ... falls below 500g
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'should follow' and 'suggests' are advisory, not mandatory; table stops at BSA 1.90 (527 g) so BSA >1.90 is effectively 500 g only
